headline: Luzardo's shutout, Schwarber's HR beat Braves 1-0
recap: Jesús Luzardo threw a complete-game shutout for the Phillies, striking out 12 over nine innings on two hits and one walk, and Kyle Schwarber's solo home run in the bottom of the eighth accounted for the only run in a 1-0 win over the Atlanta Braves on Monday at Citizens Bank Park. Braves starter Grant Holmes matched zeros for six scoreless innings before Atlanta turned to its bullpen. Schwarber's homer, his 43rd of the season, came off reliever Didier Fuentes, who took the loss. Luzardo needed 109 pitches to complete the shutout.
The win improved Philadelphia to 81-63, holding second place in the NL East, four games behind the division-leading Braves (85-59), and has now won one straight.

The Phillies open a series at home against the Houston Astros tonight, with first pitch scheduled for 6:41 PM ET. Andrew Painter is set to start for Philadelphia opposite Houston's Hayden Wesneski. DraftKings has the Phillies favored at -145 on the moneyline, with Philadelphia at -1.5 on the run line (+141).
